plan.title: Add Docker availability check
plan.description: Add a `dockerAvailable()` helper that tests whether Docker is installed and reachable (e.g., `docker info` exit code 0). Cache result for session.

plan.title: Change default config to auto-detect
plan.description: Modify `readContainerConfig()` so that when no `container.json` exists, it checks Docker availability and returns `{ enabled: true }` if Docker is available, `{ enabled: false }` otherwise. Update the DEFAULT constant in containers.ts to match.

plan.title: Update Settings UI to show Docker status
plan.description: Add a visual indicator in `container-config.tsx` showing whether Docker is detected, the current auto-detected default, and allow opt-out.

plan.title: Add Docker available server action
plan.description: Add `isDockerAvailable()` server action for the frontend to query Docker status.
